units.source_text: “K很少出门旅行，我也是头一次去房州，我们俩糊里糊涂地在船停靠的第一个码头上了岸。

en.t: K rarely went on trips, and this was my first time in Boshu as well, so the two of us, knowing nothing, got off at the first pier where the boat stopped.

units.source_text: 记得那地方叫保田，现在不知道变成什么样了，那时是个肮脏不堪的渔村，到处散发着刺鼻的鱼腥味儿。

en.t: I believe the place was called Hota. I do not know what it has become now, but at the time it was a filthy fishing village, reeking everywhere with a sharp smell of fish.

units.source_text: 而且一下海，就会被波浪冲倒，磨破手脚，因为拳头大小的石块总是随着涌动的海浪滚来滚去的。

en.t: And as soon as we went into the sea, the waves knocked us over and scraped our hands and feet, because stones the size of fists were always rolling about with the surging surf.
I soon grew tired of it.

units.source_text: 可是K既不说好，也不说不好，至少看他的脸色是无所谓的，尽管他每次下海，没有一次不受点伤的。

en.t: But K said neither that it was good nor that it was bad; at least from his expression he seemed indifferent, even though every time he went into the sea he always came away with some injury.

units.source_text: 我好歹说服了他，从那里去了富浦，又从富浦去了那古。

en.t: Somehow I managed to persuade him, and we went from there to Tomiura, then from Tomiura on to Nago.

units.source_text: 那时候开始，这边沿岸一带就是学生们聚集的地方了，所以无论到哪里，都是正合我们口味的海滨浴场。

en.t: Even then, that stretch of coast was already a place where students gathered, so wherever we went, the seaside bathing spots suited us perfectly.

units.source_text: K和我常常坐在岸边的礁石上，眺望那遥远的海色和近处的海底。

en.t: K and I often sat on the rocks by the shore, gazing at the color of the distant sea and the seabed close below us.

units.source_text: 从礁石上俯瞰海水，感觉别有一番美妙景致，

en.t: Looking down at the water from the rocks, it seemed to have a special beauty of its own,

units.source_text: 能看到红色的、蓝色的，以及市场上见不到的奇异色彩的小鱼，在透明的海水中游来游去。

en.t: and we could see red and blue little fish, and others in strange colors never seen at the market, swimming back and forth in the clear water.
